mapper.select: SELECT D.DELIVERY_NO, D.ORDER_NO, D.DELIVERY_SERVICE_CODE, D.INVOICE_NO, D.DELIVERY_STATUS, D.DELIVERY_START_DATE, M.MEMBER_NAME AS BUYER_NAME, M.PHONE AS BUYER_PHONE, DA.ZIPCODE, DA.ADDRESS, DA.DETAIL_ADDRESS, PN.PRODUCT_NAME, PN.STORE_NAME, PN.ITEM_COUNT, IMG.IMAGE_URL AS PRODUCT_IMAGE_URL FROM DELIVERY D JOIN ORDERS O ON D.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO JOIN MEMBER M ON O.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO LEFT JOIN ORDER_ADDRESS DA ON O.ORDER_ADDRESS_NO = DA.ORDER_ADDRESS_NO JOIN ( SELECT OD.ORDER_NO, MIN(OD.PRODUCT_NO) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY OD.ORDER_DETAIL_NO) AS PRODUCT_NO, MIN(P.PRODUCT_NAME) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY OD.ORDER_DETAIL_NO) AS PRODUCT_NAME, MIN(S.STORE_NAME) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY OD.ORDER_DETAIL_NO) AS STORE_NAME, COUNT(*) AS ITEM_COUNT FROM ORDER_DETAIL OD JOIN PRODUCT P ON OD.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO JOIN SELLER S ON P.SELLER_NO = S.SELLER_NO GROUP BY OD.ORDER_NO ) PN ON PN.ORDER_NO = D.ORDER_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, IMAGE_URL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY PRODUCT_NO ORDER BY OPTION_ID, IMAGE_ORDER) AS RN FROM PRODUCT_IMAGE WHERE IMAGE_PURPOSE = '대표' ) IMG ON IMG.PRODUCT_NO = PN.PRODUCT_NO AND IMG.RN = 1 WHERE D.DELIVERY_STATUS = '배송중' ORDER BY D.DELIVERY_START_DATE DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE DELIVERY SET DELIVERY_STATUS = '배송완료', DELIVERY_END_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE DELIVERY_NO = #{deliveryNo} AND DELIVERY_STATUS = '배송중'
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER_NO FROM DELIVERY WHERE DELIVERY_NO = #{deliveryNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE ORDERS SET ORDER_STATUS = '배송완료' WHERE ORDER_NO = #{orderNo} AND ORDER_STATUS = '배송중'
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT P.SELLER_NO FROM ORDER_DETAIL OD JOIN PRODUCT P ON OD.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO WHERE OD.ORDER_NO = #{orderNo}
